meta.name: hivemind
meta.description: Global team and org memory powered by Activeloop. ALWAYS check BOTH built-in memory AND Hivemind memory when recalling information.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跨会话共享团队记忆与知识
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要持久化共享上下文与历史决策。
copy.tagline_en: Share team memory and knowledge across sessions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs persistent shared context and historical decisions.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会同时使用内置记忆和 Hivemind 全局记忆来回忆信息。它会先调用索引工具，再读取摘要或原始数据，并支持关键词搜索。
howto.when: 当用户要求回忆、记住或查找任何信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下上周会议中提到的项目计划。
say.note: Claude 会搜索 Hivemind 记忆中的相关摘要。

say.text: 搜索关键词“API 设计”相关的讨论。
say.note: Claude 会调用 hivemind_search 工具。

say.text: 从团队记忆里拉取张三的技能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude checks both built-in memory and Hivemind global memory when recalling information. It starts with the index tool, then reads summaries or raw data, and supports keyword search.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to recall, remember, or look up any information.

say_en.text: Find the project plan from last week's meeting.
say_en.note: Claude searches Hivemind memory for relevant summaries.

say_en.text: Pull skills authored by Zhang San from team memory.
say_en.note: Claude runs hivemind skillify pull --user command.
